keyEvents.text: Goal! Calvo Sotelo 0, Albacete 1. Rober González (Albacete) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Agus Medina.
Goal! Calvo Sotelo 0, Albacete 2. Mario Soberón (Albacete) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the high centre of the goal. Assisted by Agustín Albarracín.
Javi Villar (Albacete) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Daniel Bernabéu (Albacete) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Carlos Cano Díaz-Suelto (CS Puertollano) Substitution at 67'
Goal! Calvo Sotelo 0, Albacete 3. Álex Rubio (Albacete) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal.
Unai Molina Mena (CS Puertollano) Substitution at 85'
Denis Cruces Alejo (CS Puertollano) Substitution at 85'
Carlos Cano (Calvo Sotelo) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
